templates.pattern:
What is the circumference of a circle?
Statement I: The radius of the circle is 7 cm.
Statement II: The diameter of the circle is 14 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: circumference = 2πr = 2×π×7 = 44 cm. Statement II: diameter = 14, so radius = 7, circumference = 44 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a square?
Statement I: The perimeter of the square is 48 cm.
Statement II: The diagonal of the square is 12√2 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: side = 48/4 = 12, Area = 144 cm². Statement II: diagonal = 12√2, side = 12, Area = 144 cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
Is the triangle equilateral?
Statement I: All three sides of the triangle are equal.
Statement II: All three angles of the triangle are 60°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: all sides equal directly defines an equilateral triangle. Statement II: all angles 60° also directly defines an equilateral triangle. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the volume of a cube?
Statement I: The surface area of the cube is 216 cm².
Statement II: The side of the cube is 6 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: 6a² = 216, a² = 36, a = 6, Volume = 216 cm³. Statement II: side = 6, Volume = 6³ = 216 cm³. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a circle?
Statement I: The radius of the circle is 5 cm.
Statement II: The circumference of the circle is 10π cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: Area = πr² = 25π cm². Statement II: circumference = 2πr = 10π, so r = 5, Area = 25π cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
Is the quadrilateral a square?
Statement I: All four sides of the quadrilateral are equal.
Statement II: All four angles of the quadrilateral are 90°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I alone: all sides equal could be a rhombus — not necessarily a square. Statement II alone: all angles 90° could be a rectangle — not necessarily a square. Together: equal sides AND right angles confirm it is a square.

templates.pattern:
What is the side of an equilateral triangle?
Statement I: The perimeter of the triangle is 36 cm.
Statement II: The area of the triangle is 36√3 cm².
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: side = 36/3 = 12 cm. Statement II: area = (√3/4)a² = 36√3, so a² = 144, a = 12 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
Are two triangles similar?
Statement I: The three angles of both triangles are equal.
Statement II: The corresponding sides of both triangles are in the ratio 2:3.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: equal angles (AAA) directly proves similarity. Statement II: sides in constant ratio also proves similarity. Either statement alone is sufficient to confirm similarity.

templates.pattern:
What is the surface area of a sphere?
Statement I: The radius of the sphere is 6 cm.
Statement II: The diameter of the sphere is 12 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: SA = 4πr² = 4×π×36 = 144π cm². Statement II: diameter = 12, radius = 6, SA = 144π cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle?
Statement I: One side of the triangle is 9 cm.
Statement II: The area of the triangle is (81√3)/4 cm².
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: perimeter = 3×9 = 27 cm. Statement II: area = (√3/4)a² = (81√3)/4, so a² = 81, a = 9, perimeter = 27 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
Is the given triangle a right-angled triangle?
Statement I: The sides of the triangle are 5 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm.
Statement II: The largest angle of the triangle is 90°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: 5²+12² = 25+144 = 169 = 13² — Pythagoras theorem satisfied, so it is right-angled. Statement II: largest angle = 90° directly confirms right-angled triangle. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle?
Statement I: The length of the arc is 11 cm.
Statement II: The radius of the circle is 7 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Angle = (arc length / circumference) × 360°. Statement I gives arc = 11 but radius unknown. Statement II gives radius = 7 but arc unknown. Together: circumference = 44, angle = (11/44)×360° = 90°. Both needed.

incorrect: Check if one or both statements are needed 🤔
